scripts.build: vite build && tsup src/main/main.ts src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --target node20 --out-dir dist-electron --sourcemap --clean --external electron
scripts.dev: pnpm build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:electron: tsup src/main/main.ts src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --target node20 --out-dir dist-electron --sourcemap --clean --external electron
